title: Self signed certificate
body: Hi, is it possible to add an Option to use xdrip as an uploader over https (Nightscout/Freestyle Libre 2/Rest API) with a self signed certificate. I am hosting Nightscout myself (just for me) but cannot upload my data outside my home network because i dont have a domain (which i dont need to be honest), it is not possible for lets encrypt to issue a certificate for an ip number.

Can you use a dns name from some free dns provider?

Thanks for the fast response. Yes, you can but it is a painfull experience. You get a shared subdomain, txt record verification doesnt work (freedns/letsencrypt). The only way to go, set up a web server. Afterwards you have the certificate, for 90 days and a web server that you have to run just for the renew of the certificate. I have to keep two ports open and run a service that i need one time in 90 days. For a single/selfhosted user case thats overkill, in my opinion. Other than that the app is flawless, thanks for people who made that possible.
